```{r PCA plot}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

# Transpose the matrix so samples are rows
pca_input <- t(KV1.3.BULK.BRAIN.PRoteomics.normalized)

# Run PCA
pca_res <- prcomp(pca_input, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Create data frame for plotting
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)  # PCA scores
pca_df$Sample <- rownames(pca_df)
pca_df$Group <- KV1_3_Bulk_Brain_Priteomics_Metadata[rownames(pca_df), "Group"]

# Plot the first two principal components
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Bulk Brain Proteomics Data",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1], 1), "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 2], 1), "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

```


```{r Second PCA plot}
# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(factoextra)    # For scree plot (variance explained)

# Step 1: Prepare PCA input
pca_input <- t(KV1.3.BULK.BRAIN.PRoteomics.normalized)

# Step 2: Run PCA
pca_res <- prcomp(pca_input, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Step 3: Create data frame for plotting
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)  # PCA scores
pca_df$Sample <- rownames(pca_df)

# Add clean sample names
pca_df$SampleID <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(pca_df$Sample))

# Add Group info
pca_df$Group <- KV1_3_Bulk_Brain_Priteomics_Metadata[rownames(pca_df), "Group"]

# Calculate % variance explained
pc_var <- summary(pca_res)$importance[2, ]
pc1_var <- round(pc_var[1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(pc_var[2] * 100, 1)

# Step 4: PCA Plot
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = SampleID), vjust = -1, size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Group), type = "norm", linetype = 2, alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Bulk Brain Proteomics Data",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

```


```{r Scree Plot (Optional but Recommended for QC)}

fviz_eig(pca_res, addlabels = TRUE, barfill = "steelblue", barcolor = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Variance Explained by Principal Components")

```


```{r SUBSET DATA FOR DEP ANALYSIS DEPS}
#Subset metadata
# Your metadata (already has sample names as rownames)
metadata <- KV1_3_Bulk_Brain_Priteomics_Metadata

# Subset PAP1 vs CONTROL
meta_pap1_control <- metadata %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("Pap1", "Control"))

# Subset SHK vs PBS
meta_shk_pbs <- metadata %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("SHK", "PBS"))

##Subset expression matrix
# Your normalized matrix
expr <- KV1.3.BULK.BRAIN.PRoteomics.normalized
# Subset based on metadata sample names
expr_pap1_control <- expr[, rownames(meta_pap1_control)]
expr_shk_pbs <- expr[, rownames(meta_shk_pbs)]
#Save to CSV
# Save metadata
write.csv(meta_pap1_control, "metadata_PAP1_vs_CONTROL.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(meta_shk_pbs, "metadata_SHK_vs_PBS.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Save expression matrices
write.csv(expr_pap1_control, "expr_PAP1_vs_CONTROL.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(expr_shk_pbs, "expr_SHK_vs_PBS.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```
